---
title: Add scheduling/calendar integration & notifications
labels: enhancement, integrations
---

Integrate activity schedules with external calendars and add reminders/notifications.

Description
- Provide export to iCal or Google Calendar links for activities.
- Implement email reminders for upcoming activities or waitlist promotions.
- Consider webhooks or push notifications for advanced use.

Acceptance criteria
- Users can add activity schedules to their calendar via iCal link or Google Calendar URL.
- Email reminders are sent for upcoming activities (configurable window).
- Tests for calendar export generation.

Notes
- Requires user profile/email verification to send reminders.
